answer.evidence: The width profile widens from 11 (row 0) to 13 (rows 1-2) to 15 (row 3 onward), so the top reads as a bevelled cap. Rows 1-4 are a light band with a green label inset. Row 5 is a grey front-edge line (L=132) and row 6 is a very dark shadow line (L=17), which matches evidence (a). Below that, the green board (rows 7-29) and base strip (rows 30-31) form a front face of about 25 rows. The header could also be read as a face-on sign header, so the top surface is borderline: only 4 rows plus the edge line, though it does have an edge line and shadow. No side face is drawn.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical green signboard with a white 'Pharmacy' (약국) label. It carries 9 visible tones per tile, which is above bus-shelter-a (6) and below kiosk-a (12) and vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a tinted dark green rather than black, matching the references. It is simpler than kiosk-a and vending-a but equal to or richer than bus-shelter-a, which is accepted shipped art, so it sits within the modern_city standard.

surfaces.part: top header cap with green slot
main sign board with 약국 lettering (vertical face)

answer.evidence: The sign is a tall flat panel drawn face-on. Rows 7-29 are a green board with white lettering and a mid divider at row 18, inside a dark frame. The header at rows 1-5 is light and holds a green slot at row 3, which reads as a front-facing label strip rather than a horizontal surface. It is only 13 px wide at rows 1-2 and 15 px from row 3 down, so it is not an ellipse. Row 5 is a gray line and row 6 is dark, but this looks like a frame edge, not a true front-edge line with eave shadow. No ellipse, roof or visible contents appear anywhere, and no receding side face is drawn. At most a 1-2 row rim reads as top, so the whole object is a front elevation with a front face of about 24 rows (rows 7-30).

The ramp is about 4 steps (highlight, mid green, dark green, deep edge, plus white text), against about 5 on the kiosk and vending machine. Texture is limited to the panel edge highlight and the lettering, with no grain or speckle, so it is slightly sparser than the best references. It is a clean, small prop that sits acceptably next to the shelter, but it looks a little simpler than the kiosk and vending machine. In doubt, this leans slightly under the standard.
